races.paceDynamic: Land Of Spirit will take this field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting what should be a sustainable pace without early pressure from the prominent runners Baiana and Jackie Jump Up. The hold-up horses Enchanted Lady, Aughlish, Glen And Tonic and Star Reign will need the pace to collapse late to get involved. With only one pace-setter and several hold-up types, this creates a tactical scenario where the prominent runners can track and pounce, while the leaders may get away with too much. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to Land Of Spirit without having to lead, then kick when the pace inevitably quickens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Land Of Spirit sets modest fractions and the prominent runners time their moves perfectly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Baiana and Jackie Jump Up to sit in ideal positions before striking. Land Of Spirit's tendency to fade late plays into their hands as they sweep past in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Land Of Spirit builds an unassailable lead through slow early fractions
scenarios.body: The prominent and hold-up horses leave it too late to close the gap as the leader controls the tempo throughout. Despite his finishing concerns, Land Of Spirit holds on when not pressured early enough.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The moderate early gallop suits the hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks from the back. Glen And Tonic and Aughlish benefit most from a slowly-run race that becomes tactical.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Andaman Fifty shows significant improvement on debut
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced filly from a top yard produces an unexpectedly strong performance. Her unknown running style could be anything, potentially catching the others off-guard in a weak maiden.

races.paceDynamic: In The Gloaming, County Carlow, Keogie and Basilano will all want the early lead in this 9-runner maiden, creating a genuine pace battle from the off. The quartet of front runners ensures a strong gallop that will test stamina over this 6½f trip on good ground. This sustained pace will suit the hold-up horses Classical Symphony and Gia Mor who can finish strongly, while also benefiting prominent racers like Fate's Gambit and Substance who can track the pace without being embroiled in early speed duels. The multiple pace angles and likely strong gallop clearly favour horses that can settle and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field and create opportunities for hold-up horses to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. Classical Symphony and Gia Mor are ideally positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter breaks clear while others duel behind
scenarios.body: County Carlow or Keogie could steal a march if they avoid the early scrimmaging and find an uncontested lead. Their superior ratings over Basilano make them the most likely beneficiaries of this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate allowing trackers to stay handy
scenarios.body: Fate's Gambit and Substance can position perfectly behind a steadier tempo and have enough pace to strike when the race develops. Their prominent styles avoid both pace warfare and needing significant closing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If front runners go too fast and multiple leaders falter simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where any horse with remaining energy can capitalise. This chaotic finish could suit any runner that conserves energy early regardless of typical running style.

races.paceDynamic: Awakening is the only confirmed front runner in this 17-runner field and will get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The prominent runners Circus Act, Pons Aelius, Hobart, Haughty and Cornmarket will settle behind but none have the pace or inclination to challenge early. With 11 hold-up horses in the field including Desert Friend, You Make Me Smile, Lisnadill and Maxwell Smart, the race will develop into a slow-burn staying test before a cavalry charge in the final three furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce their best work late over the extended 1m6f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Awakening gets the easy lead and maintains stamina reserves for the finish
scenarios.body: The front runner dictates fractions without pressure and has enough left when the closers come calling in a race that lacks early pace pressure. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back the advantage despite the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the slow early pace allows hold-up horses to unleash sustained finishing kicks

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners like Circus Act bridges the gap between leader and pack
scenarios.body: A horse tracking the pace gets first run on the field before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenge. The tactical position proves decisive in a muddling contest.

scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse

scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where track position matters more than running style. Any horse with a clear run can win in a blanket finish.
